scientific_integrity: All universal statements have an analytic proof; arithmetic diagnostics are supplemental. The 2009-12-02 date is a verified public online date; an earlier repository catalog nominal year is not taken as a verified day of online availability.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic alternating coefficients, one species, exact sigmoid saturating Allee response and nonnegative real biomasses only. Theorem proves conditional persistence and attraction basins, not stochastic survival, empirical validation, or longer-period forcing. Priority against uninspected historical sources remains provisional.
title: Sharp seasonal-contrast extinction boundary for a sigmoid Allee population
